# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old (at the end of Volume 5)  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c28 P2](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c10 P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>; Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P4](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0004), [v2 c24 P9](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome, fair-complexioned boy with a crop of fuzzy, yellow ringlets all over his round head and dancing, roguish hazel eyes. He has a snub nose, a wide smile, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. By the age of ten, he has grown considerably, matching his schoolmate Milty Boulter in height.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c28 P2](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0002)_

## Personality

Davy is an energetic, highly inquisitive, and irrepressible boy who is constantly full of mischief and curiosity. He has an insatiable appetite, a particular fondness for plum jam, and a persistent habit of asking endless questions about everything he encounters. Though prone to impulsive misbehavior, thoughtlessness, and occasional fibs, he possesses a warm, affectionate heart, a deep devotion to Anne, and a genuine desire to improve his behavior as he grows.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c16 P2](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0002), [v2 c19 P8](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0008)_

## History

Following the death of his mother, Mary Keith, in East Grafton, Davy and his twin sister, Dora, were taken in by their third cousin, Marilla Cuthbert, and brought to live at Green Gables. Davy quickly established himself as a handful, engaging in endless mischief such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, trapping Dora in a toolhouse, placing a toad in Marilla's bed, and stealing plum jam. Despite his misbehavior, he formed a deep emotional bond with Anne Shirley, who patiently guided his moral development and taught him to tell the truth. Upon reaching school age, he attended the Avonlea school and struck up a close friendship with Milty Boulter. Following the death of his uncle Richard Keith, Davy and Dora were permanently adopted at Green Gables when a trust fund was established for their maintenance. As he grew older, Davy reformed many of his unruly habits, developed an interest in farming, and became an affectionate, helpful presence at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c14 P20](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0020), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v3 c1 P37](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0037), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned at a young age after his father died in his infancy and his sick mother, Mary Keith, died years later  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Raised in East Grafton without proper upbringing alongside his twin sister, Dora  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Adopted by Marilla Cuthbert and brought to Green Gables in Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Left an inheritance of a thousand dollars in trust by his late uncle, Richard Keith  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
